title: Count Wenzel Ferdinand Popel von Lobkowitz, imperial envoy in Paris, to Prince Ferdinand Dietrichstein: reports partly in cipher
correspondents: Wenzel Ferdinand Popel von Lobkowitz (imperial envoy to Louis XIV) -> Prince Ferdinand Joseph Dietrichstein
shelfmark: MZA Brno, G 140 Rodinný archiv Ditrichštejnů Mikulov, Historický archiv, Cizí státy > Francie, inv. č. 34
folio_note: folio count not given; "Zprávy, částečně šifrované"
status: MZA inventory: reports, partly ciphered, and correspondence: journey and arrival in Paris 1685, the ceremonial, Franco-Spanish relations (fear that France will exploit the truce). No key or decipherment mentioned.
why: The Emperor's envoy at Versailles between the Truce of Ratisbon and the Nine Years' War, writing to Leopold I's Obersthofmeister.
verify: Order scans; look for Lobkowitz's official despatches (HHStA Frankreich Berichte) with their decipherments as a parallel text.
access_note: description only on MZA ARON (www.mza.cz/aron, item record has no digital objects); scans must be ordered from the Moravský zemský archiv, Brno, or the box consulted in the reading room

folio_note: folio count not given; "kryptografické dopisy podplukovníka Saponary s číselným šifrovacím klíčem"

title: Prince Christian II of Anhalt-Bernburg to Wilhelm Verdugo: letters in cipher
correspondents: Christian II (the Younger), Prince of Anhalt-Bernburg -> Wilhelm (Guillermo) Verdugo, imperial colonel, from 1623 governor of the Lower Palatinate
shelfmark: SOA Plzeň, Rodinný archiv Verdugo, Doupov, Vilém Verdugo, Veřejná činnost, inv. č. 13 (orig. sig. C 4), kart. 2
status: SOA Plzeň inventory: folder "Kristian ml. kníže z Anhaltu", 1621-1627, writing "šifrované písmo". Verdugo captured Christian at the White Mountain (1620) and negotiated his release (May 1621); a ciphered correspondence between them afterwards is not reported in the literature found. Christian's diaries are edited (HAB Wolfenbüttel digital edition) and may name the letters.
why: A Protestant prince pardoned after the White Mountain keeping a ciphered line to the Spanish-imperial officer who had held him: a small, unexpected channel of 1620s politics.
verify: Order scans; search the digital edition of Christian II's diaries (diglib.hab.de / edition) for Verdugo and "Ziffer" to date the letters and find cribs.
access_note: description only on SOA Plzeň ARON (aron.soaplzen.cz, no digital objects); scans to order from SOA Plzeň (family archives at the Klášter u Nepomuka branch)
